template.parameter: const int id, const int o, const int t, const int e, const int period, const int crossTime

query.comment: The cyclic model should be deadlock-free.
No conflicting vehicles may cross together.
The number of active servers must not exceed M/M/1 or M/M/2 capacity.
Critical case: North-right and South-left must not cross together.
In M/M/2, two non-conflicting main-road vehicles can cross together.
